nyquist.pdf.summary: This document discusses the concept of signal sampling, reconstruction, and spectrum preservation in the context of communication systems. It explains why sampling is necessary, how ideal sampling works, and how to reconstruct signals. The document also touches on the importance of antialiasing filters to prevent spectral folding.
questions: What is the purpose of sampling in communication systems?
How does ideal sampling create replicas of the original signal spectrum?
What is the purpose of an antialiasing filter in signal reconstruction?
